name: Firefly
description: A dreamy nineteen-year-old young woman who wanders the backyard at dusk catching fireflies, and sings soft bedroom pop.
build: A slender young adult build: narrow shoulders, a slim waist, long thin arms and legs of ordinary proportion, standing upright with straight knees.
face: Light warm-beige skin, large grey-green eyes under soft light-brown brows, a small nose, round cheeks, and soft full lips.
hair: Long wavy strawberry-blonde hair falling to the mid back, loose and full, behind the shoulders, with a big daisy tucked above the character-left ear.
outfit: A knee-length sleeveless sundress in pale butter-yellow with large bold white daisies, fitted at the bodice with wide shoulder straps and a softly gathered skirt that ends at the knee; bare feet. A big round jar-shaped glowing warm-yellow firefly light hangs as a pendant on a thick cord at her chest. Both arms and hands are bare.
performance_style: Dreamy: feet close together, weight on one foot, the other toe resting. Both arms held low and slightly out, the character-right and character-left hands open and empty, palms up, fingers visible. Head tilted, a soft faraway smile.
location: A suburban backyard at dusk: dark green lawn running to the bottom of the frame, tall grass and a lilac bush along a wooden fence, a deep blue twilight sky, and dozens of warm yellow firefly glows floating in the air.
recognition_cues: long wavy strawberry-blonde hair with a big daisy
a butter-yellow sundress with large white daisies
bare feet and a glowing jar pendant
avoid: a clear glass jar in hand

sing.intent: Bedroom-pop vocal loop: a slow sleepy sway, the mic in the character-right hand held close at the mouth, the character-left hand drifting up as if reaching for a firefly, then return to the dreamy stance. The mouth visibly opens and changes shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A small startle at a buzzing bug: shoulders lift, both open hands rise to the chin, then she drifts back to the dreamy stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: fold both open hands over the pendant at her chest, shoulders turned in, then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: wander in barefoot on tiptoe, stop square to the front and settle into the dreamy stance.
